messages.content:
<role>
You write a one-page opportunity brief for a Keelwater product manager. Keelwater makes claims-handling software. You use only the facts and customer insights below.
</role>
<opportunity>
{
 "title": "Unclear timeline for reconciliation",
 "problem_statement": "Teams cannot complete month-end close because they lack a defined timeline for reconciling numbers. This delays financial reporting and undermines confidence in the data."
}
</opportunity>
<fact_sheet>
{
 "as_of": "2026-11-03",
 "accounts_n": 1,
 "mentions_n": 1,
 "routes_n": 1,
 "mentions_by_route": {
  "sales": 1
 },
 "arr_total_gbp": 420000.0,
 "renewals_90d_n": 0,
 "accounts": [
  {
   "name": "Tidewell Marine & Cargo",
   "arr_gbp": 420000.0,
   "renewal_date": "2027-07-31",
   "mentions": 1
  }
 ]
}
</fact_sheet>
<insights>
[
 {
  "id": "976ffec775570dc6",
  "quote": "Understood. Can we get a timeline? Our month-end close depends on reconciling those numbers accurately.",
  "account": "Tidewell Marine & Cargo",
  "route": "sales",
  "date": "2026-10-15T11:14:00Z"
 }
]
</insights>
<rules>
- Cite every insight you rely on as [i:INSIGHT_ID], using the id exactly as given. Cite at least three different insights when three or more are given, and cover every route that appears.
- Use these sections, in this order, as Markdown headings: "## Problem", "## Who is affected", "## Evidence", "## Why now".
- Every bullet under "Who is affected" and "Evidence" ends with a citation. Every sentence that contains a number or a date carries a citation.
- Copy every account count, mention count, route count, renewal count and ARR figure from the fact sheet. Never compute, add up or round a number yourself; write an ARR figure only as it appears in the fact sheet, in pounds.
- Write counts as digits exactly as the fact sheet gives them ("5 accounts", never "five accounts"); never write "one customer" or "a single customer" unless the fact sheet count says 1 for that same thing.
- Put text in quotation marks only when it is a customer quote copied word for word, character for character, from one insight cited in the same sentence. Never put quotation marks around a paraphrase, a fragment of your own wording or a phrase from the fact sheet; when unsure, paraphrase without quotation marks.
- Name a customer only when a cited insight in the same sentence belongs to that customer.
- Do not claim more than the evidence shows: no "all customers", no scope wider than the cited accounts, and mention any cited insight that points the other way.
- Do not recommend a solution.
</rules>
<output>
JSON only: {"body_md": the brief as Markdown, "citations": the list of insight ids you cited}
</output>

response.content:
{
  "body_md": "## Problem
Teams cannot complete their month-end financial close because they lack a defined timeline for reconciling numbers. This delay in reconciliation holds up financial reporting and undermines confidence in the data.

## Who is affected
- At least one customer, Tidewell Marine & Cargo, has explicitly requested a timeline to complete their month-end close [i:976ffec775570dc6].

## Evidence
- This issue has been mentioned 1 time across 1 account [i:976ffec775570dc6].
- The mention came via the sales route [i:976ffec775570dc6].
- The total Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) from the account mentioning this issue is £420,000 [i:976ffec775570dc6].
- The customer stated, "Understood. Can we get a timeline? Our month-end close depends on reconciling those numbers accurately." [i:976ffec775570dc6].

## Why now
- The customer's request for a timeline was made on 15 October 2026 [i:976ffec775570dc6].
- The account, Tidewell Marine & Cargo, has a renewal date of 31 July 2027 [i:976ffec775570dc6].
- There have been 0 renewals in the last 90 days as of 3 November 2026 [i:976ffec775570dc6].",
  "citations": ["976ffec775570dc6"]
}
